# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue, discussion,
or pull request. Use the repository's **Security** tab and its private
vulnerability reporting option when available. If private reporting is not
available, contact the maintainer through the
[GitHub profile](https://github.com/klusik) and ask for a private reporting
channel before sending technical details.

Include the affected PHP Gallery version, the impact you observed, and concise
reproduction steps. Redact credentials, tokens, personal information, and
production data. Do not test against installations you do not own or have
permission to assess.

The maintainer will review reports as promptly as practical and may ask for
additional details. Please allow time for investigation and a fix before
publicly disclosing the issue. There is no guaranteed response or remediation
timeline.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are prioritized for the current project release. Older releases
may not receive backports; upgrading to the latest release is recommended.
